Amitabh Bachchan's iconic Jalsa bungalow in Mumbai is at the centre of a reported family property dispute. But how did this bungalow become the Bachchan family's home, and why are questions being raised about its ownership after 33 years?
Located in Juhu, Mumbai, Jalsa is one of Bollywood's most famous celebrity residences. Originally known as Mansa, the bungalow is reportedly linked to filmmaker N.C. Sippy and was associated with Amitabh Bachchan's 1982 film Satte Pe Satta.
